description: This PHP class defines an API endpoint for listing allowed languages for a specific employee in the OrangeHRM system. It handles pagination, sorting, and querying parameters, and interacts with underlying services and DAOs to fetch the data, returning a collection result with metadata.

classes.name: EmployeeAllowedLanguageAPI
classes.description: Defines a REST API endpoint for retrieving allowed languages for a specific employee, extending base Endpoint class and implementing CollectionEndpoint interface.

methods.name: getEmployeeLanguageService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the EmployeeLanguageService instance used to fetch employee language data.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list allowed languages for an employee, supports pagination and sorting, and returns collection results with metadata.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for parameters in the getAll() method, including employee number and sorting options.

methods.name: getEmpNumberRule
methods.description: Defines the validation rule for the employee number parameter.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Throws an exception as creation of new allowed language records via API is not implemented.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Throws an exception, indicating creation validation rules are not applicable.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Throws an exception as deletion of records via API is not implemented.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Throws an exception, indicating delete validation rules are not applicable.
